text_operations.label: HOME-116

As a result, +90% Initial Contact Resolution
text_operations.approved_new_raw: Selected banking results, not a forecast for every deployment: onboarding fell from 16 to 6 days, with staffing needs from 34 to 6 FTE. A separate engagement cut annual token spend from €1.8M to €300K. The 3x figure measures process-delivery speed, not onboarding time. FTE describes required capacity, not confirmed headcount cuts.
